## Interview Questions

::: {.callout-tip title="Entry Level"}
1. What is generative AI and how does it differ from traditional ML?
2. Name three categories of generative models and give an example of each.
3. What is a foundation model?
:::

::: {.callout-warning title="Mid Level"}
1. Explain the scaling hypothesis and its implications for model development strategy.
2. What are the key tradeoffs between open-source and proprietary foundation models for a production system?
:::

::: {.callout-important title="Forward Deployed Engineer"}
1. A customer asks whether they should build on top of a foundation model API or fine-tune their own. Walk through the decision framework you'd use.
2. How would you explain hallucination risk to a non-technical executive stakeholder?
:::
